leads.name: Sky Ranch Lodge champions (one-seed juniper 140 in girth 32 ft; sweet gum; London planetree 84 in 112 ft; Krauter Vesuvius plum; Mondel pine)
leads.reason: Lead, access unclear: report says Yavapai County, Sky Ranch Lodge (Airport Mesa, 1105 Airport Rd, Sedona); one-seed juniper is a national champion in 2023 (140 or 143 in, 32 ft). Sedona Chamber listing (search summary) says the 6.5-acre property is open to the public 9am to 3pm daily and holds a botanical garden certification, but that is a hotel's marketing line; no pin per tree. Needs the lodge page read and a tree-level location before shipping.

leads.name: Champion Southwestern ponderosa pine near Sedona overlooking Oak Creek Canyon (Arizona Highways photo caption: 113 ft, ~16 ft circumference)
leads.reason: Lead: caption seen in the fetched archived Arizona Highways 'Great Big Trees' article; no location beyond 'near Sedona'. A treesdb.org record (measurer Turner Sharp, 2015) lists a ponderosa 150.4 ft, 150 in girth near Cave Springs Campground low water bridge, Oak Creek Canyon, coordinate 34 00.009, -111 44.332, but that coordinate is not in the canyon (looks mistyped), so not used.
leads.species_basis: genus read from the tree's own name; ask the reader which species
